title: Mujadara (Middle Eastern Lentil and Rice Bowl)
description: A classic Middle Eastern dish made with lentils, rice, and onions, typically served with a side of salad or yogurt. This recipe is a simple and nutritious option for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the cumin and coriander and cook for 1 minute.
Add the lentils and rice, stir to combine, and cook for 2 minutes.
Add 2 cups of water to the saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until the lentils and rice are tender.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
